history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Accept Release details.
features: Accept Release Function allows the user to change the PR status from Prepared to supplied or Empty or full return status.
PR Status must be in "Prepared" status.

events.description: Opens the Accept Release - Container section in the same tab for the selected PR.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Accept Release from the single function menu.

events.description: Saves the container details for the selected PR and changes the PR Status into Full Return, Empty Return or Supplied.
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after entering all mandatory fields.

events.description: Cancels all the input values and requeries the existing data.
